guidelines.detail: kept for this example only, tied to it by: repeats

same as LRN-032 (The description assigns the evaluation to the admissions committee, but the generated task label omits that responsible participant. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-032.)

refines FID-01 (The description explicitly assigns an operational activity to a department, and the reference includes a corresponding task and flows that are absent from the generated model. This refines the broad requirement to model every distinct activity by specifying how to handle role-performed work and its connections. No extra-element record indicates that the activity was modeled using a different BPMN )

same as LRN-032 (P3 shows the generated task label omitting the admissions committee, although the description identifies it as the evaluator. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-032; the other label differences do not provide equally clear evidence of a modeling error.)

refines PROC-04 (The description specifies two distinct outcomes that end the repeated process, and the reference includes a graduation element with no generated counterpart. This applies the documented guidance on distinct outcomes specifically to exits from a recurring process.)

same as LRN-024 (The description supports preserving meaningful activity details, such as who evaluates an application and the enrollment deadline, while the label pairs show variation in specificity and wording. This guideline is already essentially stated by learned guideline LRN-024.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a process repeats until one of several terminal outcomes occurs: Model a decision that routes each terminal outcome out of the cycle and routes the continuing outcome back into the cycle.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a process repeats until one of several terminal outcomes occurs

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns an action to a particular participant or distinguishes that action from related actions: label each corresponding BPMN element with the described action and responsible participant; do not substitute another actor or conflate it with a separate action
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies who performs a modeled activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a role or department performs a distinct operational activity as part of the process, including alongside other work: Model that activity as a separate BPMN task and connect it to the surrounding activities according to the described order or parallel structure.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a role or department performs a distinct operational activity as part of the process, including alongside other work

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a recurring process continues until one of multiple distinct outcomes occurs: Model a distinct exit path for each stated outcome and represent each outcome explicitly at termination, rather than collapsing them into an undifferentiated loop exit.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a recurring process continues until one of multiple distinct outcomes occurs

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity together with a purpose, object, or scope that distinguishes what is being done: Label the corresponding BPMN task with its core action and enough of those stated details to preserve the activity’s meaning; do not add unsupported details or omit details that distinguish it.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity with details that distinguish its action or object
